prompt: Work autonomously and do not ask questions. Implement a token bucket in src/lib.rs. `new(capacity, rate)` starts full with `last = 0`. `try_take(now)` first adds `(now - last) * rate` tokens, capped at `capacity`, records `now`, then takes one token if available. `now` never goes backwards; use saturating arithmetic. Keep the public API and the existing tests unchanged. Run `cargo test` and finish only when the tests pass.
